$comment: Group Ironman rules, used by plugins/modes/GroupIronman.plugin.js (server/docs/group-ironman.md). Sources: the OSRS Wiki (Group Ironman Mode, 9 Nov 2026; The Node), the launch post (Update:Group Ironman, 6 Oct 2021), Tony's transcript, or ours where none has it. Each message says which.

wealthCaps.$comment: Wiki (Group Ironman Mode, Prestige): what a member without individual prestige may receive from group mates and group storage, by week since joining; from week 5 nothing. Counted at Grand Exchange value (ours: the Wiki doesn't say how).

hardcoreUnsafeAreas.$comment: Wiki (Group Ironman Mode, Hardcore): deaths in these cost a Hardcore group a life although they keep items for others. Matched against the plugin that owns the area the player died in (Construction: a death in a player-owned house). Not matched yet: the Camelot training room, Lunar Diplomacy's Dream World and the PvM Arena, which have no area of their own here.

formedPrestige.source: ours (Wiki: prestige is shown as a gold star)

formedNoPrestige.text: Your group was formed without Group Prestige.

formTooSmall.text: A group needs at least two members to be formed.

alreadyFormed.text: Your group has already been formed.

notIronGroup.text: You aren't in a Group Ironman group.

hardcoreNoNewMembers.text: A Hardcore group can't take new members.
hardcoreNoNewMembers.source: ours (launch post: Hardcore groups cannot accept new members)

hardcoreNoUnranked.text: A Hardcore group can't take a player who has played before.

unrankedOnly.text: An Unranked Group Ironman can only join an Unranked group.

variantMismatch.text: That player can't join your group: they play a different Group Ironman mode.

warnUnranked.text: {name} has played before: inviting them makes your group Unranked for good. Invite them again to confirm.
warnUnranked.source: ours (Wiki: a group that invites an experienced player becomes Unranked)

warnPrestige.text: Inviting a new member will cost your group its Group Prestige. Invite them again to confirm.
warnPrestige.source: ours (Wiki: members are warned before an action that costs prestige)

nowUnranked.text: Your group is now an Unranked group.

youAreUnranked.text: You are now an Unranked Group Ironman.

prestigeLost.text: Your group has lost its Group Prestige.

lifeLost.text: {name} has died. Your group has {lives} {livesWord} left.
lifeLost.source: ours (launch post: online members are told)

lifeLostLeaving.text: {name} has left the group. Your group has {lives} {livesWord} left.
lifeLostLeaving.source: ours (launch post: leaving or being kicked costs a life)

hardcoreLost.text: Your group has lost its Hardcore status. You are now a Group Ironman.
hardcoreLost.source: ours (Tony: you will all be downgraded to regular Group Iron players)

chooseMode.text: You have left your group. Choose what you become.

tradeablesDeleted.text: Your tradeable items have been deleted. You lead a new group.
tradeablesDeleted.source: ours (Wiki: all tradeable items are deleted)

becameUnranked.text: You are now an Unranked Group Ironman, leading a new group.

becameRegular.text: You are no longer an Ironman.

unrankedSwitchPending.text: You will become an Unranked Group Ironman in {days} days. Choose it again to change your mind.

unrankedSwitchCancelled.text: You will stay as you are.

unrankedSwitchDone.text: You are now an Unranked Group Ironman.

unrankedOnlyIron.text: Only Ironmen can become Unranked Group Ironmen.

capReached.text: As a new member, you can only receive {left} coins' worth from your group this week.
capReached.source: ours (Wiki: new members' wealth transfer is capped weekly)

capTradeOther.text: {name} can't receive that much from the group this week.

hardcoreOutsiders.text: {name} is in a Hardcore group, which can't take on {activity} with players outside the group until it loses its Hardcore status.
hardcoreOutsiders.source: ours (Wiki: a message explains that they may not enter until they lose the hardcore status)

prestigeOutsidersWarning.text: Taking on {activity} with players outside your group will cost your group its Group Prestige.
prestigeOutsidersWarning.source: ours (Wiki: members are warned before an action that costs prestige)

storageUnlocked.text: Your group storage has gained {slots} spaces, {total} in all.
storageUnlocked.source: ours (Update:Group Ironman Improvements: a task unlocks once a member opens the storage after doing it)

restrictedItem.text: You need to have killed {source} before you can use that.
restrictedItem.source: ours (Wiki: certain items require you to have killed the monster that drops them)
